text: のこり　じかんは　あるく　ごとに　へって　いく！

structure.en: every time you walk a step

patterns.name: 〜ごとに
patterns.explanation: ごとに after a verb means 'each time that happens'. あるく ごとに = 'with every step you walk'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: The て form plus いく shows a change that keeps going on from now. へって いく = 'keeps on going down'.
